police-patrol.reveal_note: In the AI image the vest reads 'PCILCLE' instead of POLICE with a line of gibberish above it, the yellow shoulder patch is blank with a smeared number, and the cap badge is a gold blob. The real photo has crisp, readable text on the phone the officer holds up.

handshake-city.reveal_note: In the AI image the clasped hands are tiny next to the arms and the fingers melt into one lump, the free hand on the right hangs with fused fingers, and the skyline behind is a soft smear. The real photo is a close, natural grip with real suit seams.

hooded-laptop.subject_label: Someone working on a laptop in a hoodie
hooded-laptop.reveal_note: In the AI image the hood is an empty black void with one glowing eye slit and no face, the keyboard is a blur of unreadable keys, and both monitors show meaningless boxes. The real photo is a bearded man in a grey hoodie at a laptop with a clear Apple logo.

trading-desk.subject_label: A person at a trading desk
trading-desk.reveal_note: In the AI image she stares at the camera with no hands on a keyboard, the screens behind her are soft blocks of look-alike text with no real chart, and the pendant holds a made-up glyph. The real photo has readable trading charts on several screens and hands typing.

desk-phone.subject_label: A woman on a desk phone
desk-phone.reveal_note: In the AI image the numbers on her watch face are scrambled and some run backwards, and the second phone on the shelf is a smeared blue lump. The real photo is a reception desk with a readable Dell logo on the monitor and a second person working behind.

headset-agent.subject_label: A call-centre agent with a headset
headset-agent.reveal_note: In the AI image the logo on the headset is garbled letters, the man behind her has his microphone fused into his moustache, and the rest of the room is a blur of featureless faces. The real photo is two people in plain headsets, sharp across the whole frame.

team-screen.reveal_note: In the AI image the logos on the shirts are made-up letters, the red dots on her blouse ignore the folds of the fabric, and a thin chain on the man's collar melts into the cloth. The real photo is three colleagues pointing at the same laptop.

two-factor-auth.subject_label: Entering a code on a phone
two-factor-auth.reveal_note: In the AI image the keypad is wrong: the digit 5 repeats, a letter Z sits where a number should be, the top-right key is a fused 5 and 6, and 2, 4, 7 and 8 are missing. The real keypad has 1 to 9 and 0, with small letters under each number.
